profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer & Technical Lead | Angular, .NET, AWS, Azure | CI/CD, Platform Reliability, Developer Experience
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer and Technical Lead with 7+ years of experience building Angular, .NET, AWS, and Azure platforms.

Specializes in CI/CD modernization, cloud-native architecture, and improving platform reliability and developer experience.

Proven track record of reducing deployment times, stabilizing delivery workflows, and unblocking teams through pragmatic architecture decisions.

Enjoys working on complex systems where automation, scalability, and engineering discipline matter.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Leads technical direction across multiple product teams, establishing Angular, .NET, and AWS architecture patterns to improve delivery reliability and platform stability
- Designs and implements AWS ECS sidecar patterns to bypass third-party PDF library limitations, unblocking critical document workflows
- Standardizes local development using Dev Containers and WSL, reducing onboarding friction and environment-related blockers
- Improves cloud security posture by implementing AWS RDS IAM authentication and eliminating static credentials

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led design and implementation of a build-once, deploy-many CI/CD strategy using GitHub Flow for Angular, accelerating release velocity
- Modernized containerized ASP.NET Core APIs with PostgreSQL to improve performance, scalability, and cloud readiness
- Reduced deployment time by ~10 minutes by moving Entity Framework migrations from application startup to a dedicated migration service
- Delivered organization-wide technical sessions to scale best practices across engineering teams

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Led Angular and .NET CI/CD migrations, reducing deployment times by 75%
- Designed and implemented processes to reduce Angular and .NET technical debt by 30%
- Modernized Ionic (Angular) mobile applications and CI/CD pipelines, reducing customer-reported issues
- Awarded “2022 Rising Star Award” for high-impact technical contributions
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · Linux · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · C# · API Development · Docker Products · Entity Framework · ASP.NET Core · .NET Core · Azure DevOps · REST APIs · Jira · Figma (Software) · MySQL · Angular · Code Review · Agile Application Development · Representational State Transfer (REST) · .NET

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Delivered full-stack Angular and .NET solutions supporting client-facing applications
- Improved maintainability of .NET Azure Functions by eliminating duplicated integration logic
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps to standardize deployments across environments
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · Linux · C# · API Development · Entity Framework · .NET Core · Azure DevOps · REST APIs · Jira · Angular · Code Review · Agile Application Development · Representational State Transfer (REST) · .NET

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained an Angular website for a local music festival with 20,000+ attendees 
- Analyzed web traffic metrics and reported insights to executive leadership

positions.title: Engineering Information Technology Co-op
positions.description:
- Updated and maintained Fortran engineering code in a Linux environment 
- Wrote and automated batch scripts to manage software licenses and installations

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Distributed promotional materials in specific zones, and at events in the Pittsburgh area
- Handed out promotional materials after concerts with similar demographics
